history.name: Recording a new feature
history.description: A capability that has shipped is written into the record in one command, carrying its area, size, readership, name and a plain-language description of what the product now does. It lands on the release currently in progress, and takes its place in the reading order immediately.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs — cmdAdd. Refuses an id that already exists, pointing at `ledger update` instead.
